session.resume.conflict: This conversation is open somewhere else (Codex Desktop or another terminal, say), so recovery was cancelled. Close it there and try again in about a minute; the history is kept.
session.resume.mismatch: The CLI opened a different conversation and was ended; the history is kept.
session.resume.profileMissing: Launch settings are missing (a record from before an upgrade), so it can't continue
session.resume.startupPrompt: Answer the CLI's start-up prompt in the terminal to finish recovering.
session.resume.transcriptUnverified: No conversation record could be verified, so it can't continue
session.resume.unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the CLI recovered this conversation, so it was ended; the history is kept.
session.stuck.hint: Nothing has happened for a while; it may be stuck on a screen that needs you (a slash command menu, say). Check the terminal.
session.sync.ambiguousTranscript: Couldn't tell which transcript belongs to this tmux, so no replies were imported.
session.sync.cliNotRecovered: The CLI wasn't recovered; the original history is still viewable.
session.sync.launchEnded: The chosen launch option exited; check the CLI or Janus profile settings.
session.sync.newCliFailed: The new CLI didn't start; the old history is kept. Choose a launch option again.
session.sync.newCliResultUnconfirmed: The new CLI's launch result isn't confirmed yet; it won't be sent again. Check the terminal.
session.sync.newCliStateUnknown: The new CLI's start-up state isn't confirmed yet; it won't be sent again. Check the terminal.
session.sync.newCliUnconfirmed: The new CLI's start isn't confirmed yet; it won't be sent again. Check the terminal.
session.sync.tmuxEndedClear: The tmux ended, so clearing and restarting stopped; the original history is kept.
session.sync.tmuxEndedSwitch: The tmux ended, so the conversation switch stopped; the history is kept.
session.sync.tmuxNotRecovered: The tmux wasn't recovered; the original history is still viewable.
session.transition.clearChanged: The new conversation's state has changed.
session.transition.clearConfigIncomplete: The saved CLI launch settings are incomplete, so it can't be cleared and restarted safely.
session.transition.clearExitDeliveryUnce: Couldn't confirm the CLI's exit command arrived; it stays pending. Check tmux.
session.transition.clearExitUnverified: Exiting hasn't been verified for this CLI version yet; to avoid starting it twice, it can't be cleared and restarted for now.
session.transition.clearInterruptUnverif: A reply is still in progress and this CLI's interrupt hasn't been verified; stop the reply before clearing.
session.transition.clearProfileMissing: This conversation's launch settings are missing, so it can't be cleared and restarted safely.
session.transition.clearStateChanged: The conversation's state changed, or another clear is in progress.
session.transition.cliNotFound: Couldn't find {command}. Make sure this CLI is installed, or set the right path in the launch option's settings.
session.transition.cwdMissing: This tmux's working folder no longer exists (it may have been moved or deleted), so it can't be reopened there. The conversation history is still viewable.
session.transition.forkProfileUnusable: This conversation can't be branched with the chosen launch option.
session.transition.handoffSourceChanged: The conversation being handed off from has changed, so it can't switch.
session.transition.inProgress: Another launch or switch is in progress; try again shortly.
session.transition.launchConfigIncomplet: The chosen launch option's settings are incomplete, so it can't start.
session.transition.launchDeliveryUncerta: Couldn't confirm the launch command arrived; it won't be sent again. Check tmux.
session.transition.launchUnconfirmed: The previous launch is still being confirmed; wait until the tmux state is known
session.transition.noClearAwaitingForce: No new conversation is waiting to be forced.
session.transition.noClearToCancel: There's no new conversation to cancel.
session.transition.noLaunchToCancel: There's no launch to cancel right now.
session.transition.noSwitchAwaitingForce: No switch is waiting to be forced.
session.transition.paneResetFailed: Couldn't reset the tmux screen; check the terminal.
session.transition.permissionModeConflic: This launch option's own arguments already set permissions, so a permission mode can't be added; use "CLI default", or remove those arguments from the launch option.
session.transition.permissionModeUnavail: Codex's sandbox can't run on this host, so Auto mode isn't available.
session.transition.permissionModeUnsuppo: This CLI doesn't support the chosen permission mode.
session.transition.recoveryRecordIncompl: The CLI's own conversation or the launch settings are incomplete; you can still view the saved history.
session.transition.recoveryStateChanged: This conversation is being recovered by another request, or its state has changed.
session.transition.recoveryTmuxChanged: The tmux changed state during recovery, so a second CLI wasn't started.
session.transition.recoveryTmuxChangedCa: The tmux changed state during recovery; the launch was cancelled.
session.transition.recoveryTmuxConflict: A tmux with the same name already exists and its state can't be confirmed safely, so a second CLI wasn't started.
session.transition.recoveryTmuxFailed: Couldn't safely recreate the original tmux; the conversation history is kept.
session.transition.recoveryUnconfirmed: The CLI's recovery hasn't been confirmed yet; check tmux in a moment. It won't be sent again automatically.
session.transition.resumeAccountLimited: This conversation's account is out of usage until {until}; you can still view its history.
session.transition.resumeProfileUnavaila: The saved CLI launch settings aren't available right now; you can still view the history.
session.transition.resumeTranscriptMissi: No CLI record matching this conversation was found; you can still view the saved history.
session.transition.runtimeUnrecognized: The chosen launch option's runtime isn't recognized.
session.transition.switchExitDeliveryUnc: Couldn't confirm the exit command was sent; check tmux, then try again.
session.transition.switchStateChanged: The conversation's state changed, or another operation is in progress.
session.transition.tmuxRebuildFailed: Couldn't recreate the original tmux; the conversation history is kept.
